evidence: The mass changes were measured with the time resolution of 0.5 s, which enabled us to record the behavior of film mass within a single ALD cycle. The composition of the films grown on silicon substrates was measured with Auger electron spectrometry (AES). The reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) method was applied for structure studies. The thickness and refractive index of films grown on silica substrates were determined from optical transmission spectra.
